stem: A technician records five nodes and a 2.8 cm mean internode length on Day 21, then seven nodes and a 4.1 cm mean on Day 28. A lighting change occurred between observations. Which conclusion is justified by these data alone?
choices: The sampled internode mean increased by 1.3 cm and node count increased by two; the lighting change is contextual evidence but not proof of cause
The lighting change definitely caused the architecture change
The plant entered flowering because node count increased
rationale: The measurements establish a longitudinal change. A coincident management change can generate a hypothesis, but causal attribution requires additional evidence and comparison.
